name: Brazil

elections.note: First round 4 October 2026: Flávio Bolsonaro 47.0%, Lula 45.2%.

leaders: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT)
summary: Flávio Bolsonaro narrowly led the first round on 4 October and faces incumbent Lula in the run-off. Lula is seeking a fourth, non-consecutive term.

parties.name: Flávio Bolsonaro (Liberal Party)
policies: Continues the political movement of his father, Jair Bolsonaro
Tougher policing and public security measures
Lower taxes and reduced state role in the economy
Endorsed by Caiado, Zema and other right-wing first-round candidates

parties.name: Lula da Silva (Workers' Party)
policies: Seeks a fourth term on social programmes such as Bolsa Família
Income tax exemption for lower earners funded by taxing high incomes
